name: Basculegion
description: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Aqua Jet
moves.description: The user lunges at the target to deal damage, moving at a speed that makes it almost invisible. This also raises the user's action speed.

moves.name: Bite
moves.description: The user bites the target with viciously sharp fangs to inflict damage.

moves.name: Hex
moves.description: The user attacks with relentless intensity. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's defensive stats.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target to deal damage. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Wave Crash
moves.description: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user and raises the user’s action speed.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless, life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user.
